mentions.name: lambda-autodiff
mentions.description: A Clojure automatic differentiation library inspired by Karpathy's micrograd; recently revived with bug fixes and used to implement a version of microgpt, with a GPT example published in the project documentation.
mentions.source_excerpt: Automatic differentiation library in Clojure (https://github.com/cloudkj/lambda-autodiff) - inspired by Karpathy's `micrograd` from a few years ago; dusted it off recently, fixed a few issues, and was able to use it to implement a version of `microgpt` - https://cloudkj.github.io/lambda-autodiff/doc/examples/gpt/
